faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Insect Pollinators Project, 1 Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Mustard and Groundnut Project, 1 Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Maize Landraces Project.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Maize Landraces Project: 21 to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Insect Pollinators Project, Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Mustard and Groundnut Project, Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional-I (YP-I) – Maize Landraces Project.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate degree in Agriculture or equivalent with 1st class in graduate examination (Projects 1 and 3); graduate in Agricultural Sciences/Science and related subjects with first division (Project 2). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Interview times: 11.00 AM (insect pollinators project), 12.00 PM (mustard project), 01.00 PM (maize project).

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The vacancies are purely temporary and contractual basis. Engagement on fixed remuneration under project. Number of vacancies in a particular subject may be increased/decreased or cancelled at any time without giving any reason.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application in the enclosed proforma; All original certificates; Two passport size photographs; Testimonials as per qualifications; Experience certificates issued by the concerned employers; No Objection Certificate/Experience Certificate if employed at present.
